**Handoff written** to [handoff.md](handoff.md).

Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`. The 20-slot pool filled in 33 seconds. Every 503 pairs with `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

Impact window: 02:14:18Z to past 03:59:27Z. Still failing at log end. 530 503s on node-3 alone. On-call paged at 03:21, 67 minutes in.

Roll back: `dep-4471` only. Leave `dep-4472` and `dep-4473` alone.

Next: revert the flag. Then watch `in_use` fall below 20.
